changes: One repository, three harnesses: the Codex port (origin/codex-port, 4cc973f -- the commit the v0.1.1 tag names) and the OpenCode port (origin/opencode-port, 3cdd96a) are merged onto main's v0.1.2, which keeps the Claude Code layer.

Shared judgment layer: the skills live once in .agents/skills (read by Codex and OpenCode; .claude/skills is a symlink to it) and the instructions once in AGENTS.md (CLAUDE.md is a symlink to it). Each harness keeps only its own agent definitions (.claude/agents, .codex/agents, .opencode/agents) and version hooks (.claude/settings.json, .codex/hooks.json, .opencode/plugins).

Version gate: check_version.py protects every harness's agents, hooks and the shared layer, and recognises the campaign-agent launch of all three (Agent/subagent_type, spawn_agent/agent_type, task/subagent_type); tests cover each.
SLURM templates choose the harness with HARNESS=claude|codex|opencode (default claude).
Tag note: the v0.1.1 tag predates main's 0.1.1 entry and names the Codex-port snapshot (4cc973f); main's 0.1.1 state (88d3f2a) was never tagged. Existing tags are left unmoved.

OpenCode: opencode.json sets "snapshot": false. OpenCode's per-step undo snapshot hashes the whole worktree into a shadow git store; on an NFS-hosted checkout one step took over 16 minutes and stalled the rehearsal. DeMARS does not use OpenCode's undo, so nothing it records changes.
known_limits: gates.hull needs a Materials Project API key; without it the gate stays not_run (unchecked).
The ordered-sibling search needs a user-built local ICSD index (assets/icsd_query); no ICSD data ships.
hull.tol_eV_per_atom has no default, so gates.hull reports E_above_hull with pass: null until a threshold is configured.
The frozen-state check requires a git clone with the release tag; a source zip without .git cannot run the judgment layer.

Per-harness model pins differ, each at its vendor default reasoning effort: Claude Code agents run claude-sonnet-5 at effort high (the Anthropic API default), Codex and OpenCode agents run gpt-5.6-terra at effort medium (the Codex model-catalog default). A cross-harness comparison compares model+harness pairs at vendor defaults, not equal reasoning budgets; report both with the harness.
The three agent definitions repeat the same corpus-integrity text; an edit to one must be copied to the other two.
